finding_1_correction.claim_corrected: Earlier reports read Bitwuzla runs at unwind 2/4/5/6/8 as failed unwinding assertions, i.e. insufficient bounds.
finding_1_correction.actual: Those logs show Status: ERROR on every non-trivial check and 0 FAILURE. No bitwuzla executable exists in the VM, so CBMC could not obtain a solver answer.
finding_1_correction.reproduction: A stub bitwuzla that logs its arguments and exits 127 was invoked by CBMC on the SMT2 problem and reproduced the summary: 0 of 1116 failed, 4 unreachable, 683 SUCCESS, 429 ERROR, VERIFICATION FAILED.
finding_1_correction.consequence: Whether any of those global bounds is sufficient is unknown; none was refuted. Bitwuzla has never actually been run on this obligation. Failures during symex or SSA conversion (object capacity, OOM, timeouts) are unaffected and remain valid.

finding_2_formula_size.note: Internal-node loops were being unwound although two entries never create an internal node, because symex does not see node height or length as constants.
finding_2_formula_size.observation: Symbolic parents, start and target cost almost nothing beyond a fixed tree, so enumerating fixed trees would not help.
